caption: The drawing depicts a pattern with botanical elements arranged across a light gray background. The central focus is a branch with three large round fruits, colored in shades of orange, red, yellow, and a touch of purple, attached to green leaves with visible veins. Surrounding this central branch are several smaller clusters of round berries, illustrated in red-orange and light yellow colors. These berries are connected to thin, twisting, brown branches that meander throughout the composition. The scene also includes multiple clusters of green leaves, some singly and others in groups, extending from the branches. The overall arrangement is sparse, with objects distributed evenly against the plain gray backdrop, framed by a wide cream-colored border.
title: Wallpaper
